name: Webflow
title: webflow.com
shortDescription: Webflow is a visual website building platform that allows designers and marketers to create custom websites without coding. Users can design, publish, and scale sites using a drag-and-drop interface and CMS. An example use case is a marketing team quickly deploying a promotional site with integrated analytics and SEO tools.
cons: Steep learning curve for new users
Higher cost compared to basic site builders

aiSuggestedAlternatives.name: Squarespace
aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Easier for beginners with less flexibility.

aiSuggestedAlternatives.name: Wix
aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Similar visual builder with more templates.
